reviews.summary: BIRB is ambiguous: current sources identify both a legacy Base/BSC Birb and Moonbirds’ Solana BIRB. The €0.10 snapshot is consistent with Moonbirds, but no venue, contract address, or chain was supplied to verify the traded asset.

facts.fact: At least two materially different assets use ticker BIRB: legacy Birb and Moonbirds’ Solana token. ([coingecko.com](https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/birb?utm_source=openai))

If the market is Moonbirds BIRB, a November 4 scan reported the top 10 wallets held 88.6% of supply—material concentration risk, though this is third-party data. ([codeflex.si](https://codeflex.si/scan/G7vQWurMkMMm2dU3iZpXYFTHT9Biio4F4gZCrwFpKNwG/?utm_source=openai))

Phemex announced it would delist its BIRB/USDT spot pair on August 18, 2026; this does not establish any issue with the unspecified BIRB-EUR venue. ([phemex.com](https://phemex.com/announcements/phemex-will-delist-the-perp-usdt-spot-pair-100991?utm_source=openai))
